text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Wait, is that claw a little on the
weak side or
somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
They cranked the difficulty up to the
max, so ya
wouldn't get anythin' no
matter how good ya are.
Yeah, that must
be it...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Put your wallet away! This thing's a
sinkhole!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Guh... No, don't do it! I can't stand seein'

perfectly good coins vanish before my
eyes!
